dedupe_keys.name: nppad nuclear accident generation and processing scripts

description: The Tsinghua University NPPAD repository provides Python methods for converting simulated nuclear-plant accident records into analysis and machine-learning inputs. The documented methods convert Microsoft Access MDB tables to CSV, construct labelled supervised-learning samples and plot physical parameters. A separate automation-script folder records accident-generation steps. Coverage is generic pressurised-water-reactor scenarios and their simulation time, not measured events at a named plant. GitHub supplies the source for free under MIT. The tool prepares data-nppad-nuclear-power-plant-accident-data for diagnosis and emergency-response benchmarks related to platform-pctran-nuclear-plant-simulator. A caveat is that MDB conversion depends on the Microsoft Access ODBC driver, and example code needs checking before reuse. The current file inventory does not include the Simulator directory linked by the 2022 paper. Consequently this record does not promise a complete runnable PCTRAN distribution or extend MIT terms to that separate simulator. No code was executed.
